name: Deadly Traps
text:
Overcome 2 successes; DC 34 Arcana check or DC 34 Thievery check

---

The PCs suppress or disable dangerous traps set to kill would-be thieves and make an explosive ruckus.

Special If a PC fails a check to overcome this scene, they trigger a trap that deals 16d6 untyped damage to that PC (DC 36 basic Reflex save). If the PC critically fails, it deals this damage to all PCs in the scene.
